notes: T491 grows claimlint C11 UNAUDITED: a findings file dated on/after 2026-08-19 (the D2 audit-policy ruling date, AUDIT_POLICY_DATE) that proposes a tier-A status change — a claim -> PROVEN, -> FALSE or -> FALSE-AS-SCOPED, or -> SUPERSEDED (retired, T269) in claims[].proposed_status or new_rows[].status — must carry a top-level non-empty `audited_by` field. One auditor per findings file (the audit is of the task's results, not per claim). The check FAILS the run (c11_unaudited > 0 joins shouldFailRun, exit 1), not report-only: a check that reports but exits 0 is the 'tool reports success while doing nothing' failure mode the policy exists to end, and the policy sheet itself says 'until that check exists, the policy is prose'. The two tier-A classes without a status marker in the findings schema (instrument rows, register-entering experiments) are enforced by the dispatch layer, not by C11, because C11 sees only claim-status proposals. Scope decisions verified by four inline unit tests (zig test src/claimlint.zig, the acceptance, 4/4 pass) and four runtime calibration arms: known-bad (post-ruling PROVEN without audited_by -> 1 violation, caught), known-good (same WITH audited_by -> silent), known-good (pre-ruling FALSE-AS-SCOPED -> grandfathered, silent), known-good (post-ruling CLAIMED, non-tier-A -> silent).
